Course Duration <x> Study Modes <x> Study Locations <x> Start Dates March (S1), Aug (S2), November (Summer) Fees $2,425 per subject FEE-HELP" - the header fee is the DOMESTIC per-subject fee, never read as fee; no international annual fee is printed on stored pages. English is in Admission Criteria: "International Students - Language Requirements IELTS (or equivalent) Score of 6.0 (with no score below 5.5 ...)" and varies by course (5.5 to 7.5). The generic "Key Dates Semester 1 Term 1 February / March Term 2 April Semester 2 Term 3 July / August Term 4 November" block (also https://www.ac.edu.au/key-dates/) is on every page and is not used; month names are printed in Start Dates so term_months is not needed. Central: https://www.ac.edu.au/study/international/ says the IELTS minimum differs by award.
